result.question: Qual o crescimento percentual anual de internações no estado do RS entre 2008 e 2023?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano) AS ano_anterior, ROUND((total_internacoes - LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano)) * 100.0 / LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano), 2) AS pct_crescimento FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_ano AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") IN (2008, 2023) GROUP BY ano ), ano_comparacao AS ( SELECT a1.ano, a1.total_internacoes AS total_ano, a2.total_internacoes AS total_ano_anterior, ( (a1.total_internacoes - a2.total_internacoes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(a2.total_internacoes, 0) ) AS crescimento_percentual FROM internacoes_por_ano a1 LEFT JOIN internacoes_por_ano a2 ON a1.ano = a2.ano + 15 ) SELECT ano, total_ano, total_ano_anterior, ROUND(crescimento_percentual, 2) AS crescimento_percentual FROM ano_comparacao;
